     BUSINESS REVIEW AND OUTLOOK                                                       業務回顧與展望
     2023 marked a remarkable recovery for the Chinese travel industry. In the first   二零二三年標誌著中國旅遊業的顯著復甦。今
     half of the year, the industry demonstrated a strong resurgence, reflecting       年上半年，行業呈現出強勁的回升勢態，反映

     market reached its pinnacle and was marked by the significant increase in         市場達到頂峰，暑假期間旅遊活動顯著增加。
     travel activities during the summer holidays. Despite the low season for travel   儘管第四季度是旅遊淡季，但旅遊需求依然強
     in the fourth quarter, travel demand remained strong especially during the        勁，尤其是在國慶假期期間，顯示旅遊興趣持
     National Day holiday period, indicating sustained and robust travel interest.     續旺盛。

which we take inventory risk. Revenue recognized on a gross basis represents    現。按總額基準確認的收入指就銷售間夜向用
the amounts billed to the users for the room nights sold, while the prices at   戶開出單據的金額，而我們向住宿供應商買斷
which we pre-purchase the room nights from the accommodation suppliers          間夜的價格列作銷售成本。
are recorded as cost of revenue.

Development in the PRC legislation on foreign investment                          有關外國投資的中國法例的發展

On March 15, 2019, the National People’s Congress promulgated the Foreign         於二零一九年三月十五日，全國人民代表大會
Investment Law (外商投資法) (the “FIL”), which took effect on January 1,               頒佈《外商投資法》
                                                                                          （「外商投資法」），該法已於
2020. The FIL replaces the laws regulating foreign investment in PRC, namely,     二零二零年一月一日生效。外商投資法取代了
the Sino-foreign Equity Joint Venture Enterprise Law, the Sino-foreign            中國規管外商投資的法律，即《中外合資經營
Cooperative Joint Venture Enterprise Law and the Wholly Foreign-invested          企業法》、《中外合作經營企業法》及《外資企業
Enterprise Law. The FIL embodies an expected regulatory trend in PRC to           法》。外商投資法體現出預期的中國監管趨勢，
rationalize its foreign investment regulatory regime in line with prevailing      疏理其外商投資規管制度以符合當前國際慣例
international practice and the legislative efforts to unify the corporate legal   及立法措施，以統一國內外投資的公司法律規
requirements for both foreign and domestic investments.                           定。


The FIL does not explicitly stipulate the contractual arrangements as a form      外商投資法並無明確規定合約安排為一種外商
of foreign investment. The FIL does not mention concepts including “de            投資形式。外商投資法並無提及包括「實際控制
facto control” and “controlling through contractual arrangements” nor does        權」及「通過合約安排進行控制」 的概念，亦並
it specify the regulation on controlling through contractual arrangements.        無具體說明通過合約安排進行控制的規定。此
Furthermore, the FIL does not specifically stipulate rules on the Relevant        外，外商投資法並無具體訂明就相關業務實行
Businesses. Instead, the FIL stipulates that “foreign investors invest in PRC     的規則。相反，外商投資法規定「外國投資者通

  Tongcheng Travel Holdings Limited (the “Company”) is an exempted              同程旅行控股有限公司（「本公司」）為一間

  Company is Cayman Corporate Centre, 27 Hospital Road, George Town,            註冊辦事處為Cayman Corporate Centre, 27

                                                                                KY1-9008, Cayman Islands。

                                                                                （「上市」）。


  The Company is an investment holding company. The Company and                 本公司為一間投資控股公司。本公司及其
  its subsidiaries (together, the “Group”) are principally engaged in the       附屬公司（統稱「本集團」）主要在中華人民

  scenic spot area in the People’s Republic of China (the “PRC”).               營旅遊景區。

                                                                                  3.3 公允價值估計
     (a) Financial instruments in level 1                                           (a) 第1層金融工具

         The fair value of financial instruments traded in active markets               於活躍市場買賣的金融工具的公允
         is based on quoted market prices at the reporting date. A                      價值乃基於報告日期的市場報價。
         market is regarded as active if quoted prices are readily and                  倘交易所、交易商、經紀、行業組
         regularly available from an exchange, dealer, broker, industry                 織、定價服務機構或監管機構隨時
         group, pricing service, or regulatory agency, and those prices                 定期提供報價，且該等價格代表實
         represent actual and regularly occurring market transactions                   際定期進行的公平市場交易，則市
         on an arm’s length basis. The quoted market price already                      場被視為活躍。市場報價已經包含
         incorporates the market’s assumptions with respect to changes                  了市場對經濟環境變化（例如利率
         in economic climate such as rising interest rates and inflation,               上升和通貨膨脹）以及 ESG 風險變
         as well as changes due to ESG risk.                                            化的假設。


     (b) Financial instruments in level 2                                           (b) 第2層金融工具

         The fair value of financial instruments that are not traded in                 並無於活躍市場買賣的金融工具公
         an active market is determined by using valuation techniques.                  允價值以估值技術釐定。該等估值
         These valuation techniques maximize the use of observable                      技術盡量利用既有可觀察市場數
         market data where it is available and rely as little as possible on            據，盡量少依賴實體的特定估計。
         entity specific estimates. If all significant inputs required to fair          倘計算某工具的公允價值所需的所
         value an instrument are observable, the instrument is included                 有重大輸入值為可觀察數據，則該
         in level 2.                                                                    工具計入第2層。


     (c) Financial instruments in level 3                                           (c) 第3層金融工具

         If one or more of the significant inputs is not based on                       倘一項或多項重大輸入值並非基於
         observable market data, the instrument is included in level 3.                 可觀察市場數據，則該工具計入第
                                                                                        3層。


         Specific valuation techniques used to value financial                          用於評估金融工具的專門估值技術
         instruments include:                                                           包括：


         •    Quoted market prices or dealer quotes for similar                         •   市場報價或交易商對類似工具
              instruments.                                                                  的報價。


         •    Other techniques, such as discounted cash flow or                         •   貼現現金流量或預期可收回現
              excepted recoverable cash flows analysis are used to                          金流量分析等其他技術用於釐
              determine fair value for financial instruments.                               定金融工具公允價值。

  (d)   The Group’s leasing activities and how these are accounted for                    (d)   本集團的租賃活動及其如何入賬

        As a lessee, the Group’s leases are mainly in connection with land-use-rights           作為承租人，本集團的租賃主要關於土地使
        and leases of buildings or vehicles. Rental contracts are typically made for            用權以及樓宇或車輛的租賃。租賃合約一般
        fixed periods of 1 to 50 years. Lease terms are negotiated on an individual             按固定期限訂立，介乎一至五十年。租賃條
        basis and contain a wide range of different terms and conditions. The lease             款按個別基準磋商，並包含各種不同的條款
        arrangements do not impose any covenants, but leased assets (other than                 及條件。租賃安排並無施加任何契諾，惟租
        land-use-rights) may not be used as security for borrowing purposes.                    賃資產（土地使用權除外）不得用作借款的抵
                                                                                                押品。

        Contracts may contain both lease and non-lease components. The Group                    合約可能包含租賃及非租賃組成部分。本集
        allocates the consideration in the contract to the lease and non-lease                  團根據租賃及非租賃組成部分的相對獨立價
        components based on their relative stand-alone prices. However, for leases              格分配其合約中的代價。然而，就本集團作
        of real estate for which the Group is a lessee, it has elected not to separate          為承租人的房地產租賃而言，其已選擇不將
        lease and non-lease components and instead accounts for these as a single               租賃及非租賃組成部分分開，而是作為單一
        lease component.                                                                        租賃組成部分入賬。

                The lease payments are discounted using the interest rate implicit in the                 租賃付款使用租賃中隱含的利率進行貼現。
                lease. If that rate cannot be readily determined, which is generally the case             倘無法輕易確定該利率（為本集團租賃的一
                for leases in the Group, the lessee’s incremental borrowing rate is used,                 般情況），則使用承租人的增量借款利率，
                being the rate that the individual lessee would have to pay to borrow the                 即個別承租人在類似經濟環境中按類似條
                funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar value to the right-of-use asset in          款、抵押及條件借入獲得與使用權資產具有
                a similar economic environment with similar terms, security and conditions.               類似價值的資產所需資金而必須支付的利
                                                                                                          率。

                To determine the incremental borrowing rate, the Group:                                   為釐定增量借款利率，本集團：

                •    where possible, uses recent third-party financing received by the                    •   在可行情況下，使用個別承租人最近獲
                     individual lessee as a starting point, adjusted to reflect changes in                    得的第三方融資作為出發點，並作出調
                     financing conditions since third party financing was received;                           整以反映自獲得第三方融資以來融資條
                                                                                                              件的變動；

                •    uses a build-up approach that starts with a risk-free interest rate                  •   使用累加法，首先就本集團所持有租賃
                     adjusted for credit risk for leases held by the Group, which does not                    的信貸風險（最近並無第三方融資）調
                     have recent third party financing; and                                                   整無風險利率；及

                •    makes adjustments specific to the lease, e.g. term, country, currency                •   作出租賃特定的調整，例如期限、國
                     and security.                                                                            家、貨幣及抵押。

                If a readily observable amortizing loan rate is available to the individual               倘個別承租人可獲取易觀察攤銷貸款利率
                lessee (through recent financing or market data) which has a similar payment              （通過近期融資或市場數據），且其付款情況
                profile to the lease, then the group entities use that rate as a starting point           與租賃相似，則本集團實體使用該利率作為
                to determine the incremental borrowing rate.                                              釐定增量借款利率的起始點。

                Right-of-use assets are generally depreciated over the shorter of the                     使用權資產一般於資產可使用年期及租賃期
                asset’s useful life and the lease term on a straight-line basis. If the Group is          （以較短者為準）以直線法予以折舊。倘本集
                reasonably certain to exercise a purchase option, the right-of-use asset is               團合理確定行使購買選擇權，則使用權資產
                depreciated over the underlying asset’s useful life.                                      於相關資產的可使用年期內予以折舊。

          and hence they are classified as “held for trading” for accounting              則，因此就會計目的而言彼等被分類為「持
          purposes and are accounted for as financial assets/(liabilities) at fair        作買賣」並入賬列作按公允價值計量且其變
          value through profit or loss.                                                   動計入損益的金融資產 ╱（負債）。


          The full fair value of hedging derivatives is classified as a non-current       當對沖項目的剩餘到期日超過 12 個月時，

          more than 12 months. It is classified as a current asset or liability when      流動資產或負債。當對沖項目的剩餘到期
          the remaining maturity of the hedged item is less than 12 months.               日少於 12 個月時，其被分類為流動資產或
          Trading derivatives are classified as a current asset or liability.             負債。交易衍生工具被分類為流動資產或

          (a)   Classification as trade receivables                                                 (a)   分類為貿易應收款項

                Trade receivables are amounts due from customers for products sold or                     貿易應收款項為就日常業務過程中售出的產
                services performed in the ordinary course of business.                                    品或開展的服務而應收客戶的款項。

                Trade receivables are classified as current assets if settlement is due within            貿易應收款項若在一年內到期結算，則歸類
                one year. If not, they are presented as non-current assets.                               為流動資產，否則呈列作非流動資產。

                is unconditional unless they contain significant financing components, when               認，除非其包括重大融資組成部分，屆時其
                they are recognized at fair value. The Group holds the trade receivables with             按公允價值確認。本集團持有貿易應收款項
                the objective of collecting the contractual cash flows and therefore measures             的目的是收取合約現金流量，因此後續使用
                them subsequently at amortized cost using the effective interest method.                  實際利率法按攤銷成本計量貿易應收款項。

      26. TRADE PAYABLES (CONTINUED)                                                               （續）
                                                                                          26. 貿易應付款項
          Trade payables are obligations to pay for goods or services that have            貿易應付款項為就於日常業務過程中向供
          been acquired in the ordinary course of business from suppliers.                 應商獲取的貨品或服務的付款責任。倘貿
          Where trade payables are settled via electronic cash transfer, they are          易應付款項通過電子現金轉賬結算，則當
          derecognized when the Group has no ability to withdraw, stop or cancel           本集團無法提取、停止或取消付款、因電
          the payment, has lost the practical ability to access the cash as a result       子支付指示而失去實際使用現金的能力時
          of the electronic payment instruction, and the risk of a settlement not          終止確認該等款項，無法進行結算的風險
          occurring is insignificant.                                                      並不重大。


          Trade payables are classified as current liabilities if payment is due within    倘貿易應付款項於一年或更短時間內到期
          one year or less. If not, they are presented as non-current liabilities.         支付，則分類為流動負債，否則呈列為非
                                                                                           流動負債。


          Trade payables are recognized initially at fair value and subsequently           貿易應付款項初步按公允價值確認，其後
          measured at amortized cost using the effective interest method.                  則使用實際利息法以攤銷成本計量。


          The carrying amounts of trade payables approximate their fair values as          於二零二三年及二零二二年十二月三十一
          at December 31, 2023 and 2022.                                                   日，貿易應付款項的賬面值與其公允價值
                                                                                           相若。

      37. RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS                                                            37. 關聯方交易
          Parties are considered to be related if one party has the ability, directly                 倘一方有能力直接或間接控制另一方，或
          or indirectly, control the other party or exercise significant influence                    能對另一方的財務及經營決策行使重大影
          over the other party in making financial and operation decisions. Parties                   響力，則雙方被視為關聯方。倘雙方受共
          are also considered to be related if they are subject to common control.                    同控制，亦被視為關聯方。本集團主要管
          Members of key management and their close family member of the                              理層成員及彼等的近親亦被視為關聯方。
          Group are also considered as related parties.


          Save as disclosed in elsewhere in these consolidated financial                              除本綜合財務報表其他章節所披露者外，

  41.13 Provisions                                                               41.13 撥備

      Provisions are recognized when the Group has a present legal or               倘本集團因過往事件而具有現時法定
      constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is probable that       或推定責任，而履行該等責任可能需
      an outflow of resources will be required to settle the obligation;            要資源流出，且所涉及的金額能可靠
      and the amount has been reliably estimated. Provisions are not                地估計，則會確認撥備。未來經營虧
      recognized for further operating losses.                                      損毋須確認撥備。


      Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood               如有多項類似責任，則在償付時所需
      that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by               的流出的可能性乃根據責任類別的整
      considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is               體考慮而釐定。即使在同一責任類別
      recognized even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to any           所包含的任何一個項目相關的資源流
      one item included in the same class of obligations may be small.              出的可能性極低，仍須確認撥備。


      Provisions are measured at the present value of the management’s              撥備採用反映當時市場對金錢時間值
      best estimate of the expenditures expected to be required to settle           及責任特定風險之評估之稅前比率，
      the obligation using a pre-tax rate that reflects current market              按照管理層對預期履行責任所需支出
      assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the          之最佳估計之現值計量。隨著時間流
      obligation. The increase in the provision due to passage of time is           逝而增加之撥備確認為利息開支。
      recognized as interest expense.


  41.14 Interest income                                                          41.14 利息收入

      Interest income is calculated by applying the effective interest rate         利息收入乃通過應用實際利率於金融
      to the gross carrying amount of a financial asset except for financial        資產賬面總值來計算，惟後續發生信
      assets that subsequently become credit-impaired. For credit-                  貸減值的金融資產除外。就發生信貸
      impaired financial assets the effective interest rate is applied to the       減值的金融資產而言，則應用實際利
      net carrying amount of the financial asset (after deduction of the            率於金融資產的賬面淨值（扣除虧損撥
      loss allowance).                                                              備後）。


      Interest income from financial assets measured at fair value is               按公允價值計量之金融資產的利息收
      recognized in profit or loss as part of “fair value changes on                入於損益確認為「按公允價值計量且其
      investments measured at fair value through profit or loss”.                   變動計入損益的投資公允價值變動」的
                                                                                    一部分。
